name: Yui Yamashita
source:
President of the Student Council. She takes her position very seriously and is very strict in following the rules and policing others to do the same. She and [url=https://vndb.org/c174069]John[/url] were actually childhood friends due to their mothers' friendship, but drifted apart in teenhood.
